messages.author: 23eee65194c38a7c
messages.subject: Resource's  queue_size
parts:
Is it possible to have 2 o more queues on a same resource?

what I'm trying to do is to make a item follow the following trajectory:

start -> resource1 ->resource2->resource3->resource4->resource1->exit

Where "resource1" has a queue for items comming from "start" and one queue comming from "resource4".

Regards.

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Resource's queue_size
parts:
At the moment, simmer doesn't support multiple queues per resource. You could arrange auxiliary resources to emulate them though.
